At **9.1 degrees**, the Moon is about 10 degrees above the horizon. For context, if you hold your hand out at arm's length, a clenched fist represents about 10 degrees of the sky. ### 2. The Illumination (Phase)
At **91.24% illumination**, the Moon is in its "Waxing Gibbous" phase (very close to being a Full Moon). A moon this bright is extremely easy to spot even with the naked eye. It will be one of the most dominant objects in the night sky.
